start.opening: Namaste Kabir, main Asha, aapki AI teacher hoon. Aaj animals mein respiration padhenge. Aapka favourite animal kaunsa hai?

turns.line: बिना ऑक्सीजन के जी नहीं सकते
turns.reply: Aapne kaha, “bina oxygen ke jee nahi sakte”—is baat par ant mein lautenge. Pehle running ke baad saans kyun tez hoti hai, aapka prediction?
